verdict.rationale: Render's site explicitly claims fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability, which covers every element of the story. The docs also mention datastores with advanced recovery features that can be managed from the CLI. The evidence is only marketing-level, though, and never names Postgres as the engine. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the managed database is Postgres, in-depth docs on PITR/replica/HA configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
